description: Implement OR-3 / TASK-8.4: a new CDK PipelineStack (infra/stacks/pipeline_stack.py) wired into infra/app.py that defines ONE AWS CodePipeline building and deploying BOTH backend and frontend. GitHub is source-only via a CodeStar connection on `main`. Stages: Source -> Build (backend `docker build` + push to the ApiStack ECR repo tagged with commit SHA + `latest`; frontend `npm ci && typecheck && build`) -> Test (`pytest`, red fails the pipeline) -> Backend Deploy (`alembic upgrade head`, roll the ECS service, wait for ALB `/health`) -> Frontend Deploy (`s3 sync frontend/dist` into the WebStack bucket + CloudFront invalidation) -> Manual approval before prod. Follow the existing stack patterns (module/class docstrings, Creates/Properties/Outputs sections, heavy inline comments, context-driven parameterization). Thread the needed cross-stack resources (ApiStack ECR repo + ECS cluster/service, WebStack bucket + distribution, SecretsStack/DatabaseStack secret references for CodeBuild to read at deploy time) as keyword-only constructor args from app.py so dependency edges form. This feature is independent of FEAT-003 (they touch different files) but FEAT-003's cutover decision depends on this stage existing.
steps: Create infra/stacks/pipeline_stack.py defining class PipelineStack(Stack). Mirror the docstring + commentary style of pipeline_oidc_stack.py and api_stack.py. Keyword-only constructor args: env_name: str, ecr_repo (ApiStack.ecr_repo), cluster (ApiStack.cluster), service (ApiStack.service), web_bucket (WebStack.bucket), web_distribution (WebStack.distribution), and the ISecret references needed at deploy time (db_secret from DatabaseStack, flask_secret/openai_secret from SecretsStack if a deploy/migration step needs DB access). Resolve context: `githubRepo` (default DEFAULT_GITHUB_REPO='your-org/recipemate'), `codestarConnectionArn` (default a documented placeholder ARN so synth works without it; document that the operator creates the CodeStar GitHub connection once in the console/CLI and supplies its ARN via `-c codestarConnectionArn=...`), and `env` already selects staging/prod. Pin all constructs to region us-east-2 implicitly via the stack env from app.py (do not hardcode region strings).

Source stage: use aws_codepipeline_actions.CodeStarConnectionsSourceAction with connection_arn from context, owner/repo parsed from githubRepo (split on '/'), branch='main', output to a source artifact. Use the CodeStar connection (NOT GitHubSourceAction v1/v2 OAuth).

Build stage: define CodeBuild PipelineProject(s). Backend build: privileged (Docker) build environment (aws_codebuild.LinuxBuildImage.STANDARD_7_0, privileged=True) that logs into ECR, runs `docker build -t $REPO_URI:$CODEBUILD_RESOLVED_SOURCE_VERSION -t $REPO_URI:latest .` using the repo-root Dockerfile, and pushes both tags to the ApiStack ECR repo (pass the repo URI/name + region/account as CodeBuild env vars; grant the project's role ECR push via ecr_repo.grant_pull_push(project)). Frontend build: a Node build (LinuxBuildImage.STANDARD_7_0) running `cd frontend && npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run build`, with build-time VITE_* values sourced from CodeBuild environment variables backed by SSM parameters (document the SSM parameter names, e.g. /recipemate/<env>/frontend/VITE_API_BASE_URL etc.; use aws_codebuild.BuildEnvironmentVariable with type PARAMETER_STORE). Output the frontend/dist as a build artifact for the frontend deploy stage. Emit an imagedefinitions/image-tag artifact (or export the SHA tag) for the backend deploy to consume. Decide inline vs file-based buildspecs — RECOMMENDATION: inline buildspecs via aws_codebuild.BuildSpec.from_object in the stack keeps everything in one reviewable place and matches the self-contained style of the other stacks; document the choice in the module docstring.

Test stage: a CodeBuild project running the pytest suite (install requirements.txt + requirements-dev.txt, then `pytest`). A non-zero pytest exit must fail the stage and therefore the pipeline (CodeBuild propagates non-zero exit as FAILED by default). Place this stage AFTER build and BEFORE any deploy so red tests block deploys.

Backend deploy stage: a CodeBuild project (or codepipeline ECS deploy action) that (a) runs `alembic upgrade head` against the environment DB (DATABASE_URL composed from the DatabaseStack secret via secretsmanager — fetch at runtime, never bake the value; grant db_secret.grant_read to the project role), (b) updates the ECS service to the new image tag (either `aws ecs update-service --force-new-deployment` on cluster/service, or register a new task def revision pointing at the SHA tag then update — document which; grant ecs:UpdateService/DescribeServices + the needed iam:PassRole scoped to the task roles), and (c) waits for rollout + the ALB /health target group to be healthy (`aws ecs wait services-stable` and/or poll the target group health). Scope all IAM to the specific cluster/service/secret ARNs, no wild*.

Frontend deploy stage: a CodeBuild project (or S3 deploy action) that takes the frontend/dist artifact, runs `aws s3 sync frontend/dist s3://<web_bucket> --delete`, then `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id <web_distribution.id> --paths '/*'`. Grant web_bucket.grant_read_write + grant_delete and a CloudFront invalidation statement scoped to the distribution ARN (mirror WebStack's web_deploy_role policy exactly).

Manual approval: add an aws_codepipeline.StageProps manual-approval action BEFORE the prod deploy actions. Since each env has its own pipeline (RecipeMate-Staging-Pipeline / RecipeMate-Prod-Pipeline), gate the PROD pipeline's deploy stages behind a ManualApprovalAction; for staging the approval may be omitted or made conditional on env_name=='prod'. Document the per-env behavior in the docstring.

Add CfnOutputs: PipelineName, and any ARNs/names the operator needs (e.g. the CodeStar connection ARN echoed back, the backend/frontend CodeBuild project names). Follow the 'store as ...' description convention.

Wire into infra/app.py: import PipelineStack, instantiate as `PipelineStack(app, f'{prefix}-Pipeline', env=cdk_env, env_name=config.name, ecr_repo=api_stack.ecr_repo, cluster=api_stack.cluster, service=api_stack.service, web_bucket=web_stack.bucket, web_distribution=web_stack.distribution, db_secret=database_stack.secret, flask_secret=secrets_stack.flask_secret, openai_secret=secrets_stack.openai_secret)`. Add an explanatory comment block matching the existing ones. Keep it after web_stack/pipeline_oidc_stack so dependency ordering is natural.

Add a CodePipeline artifact bucket consideration: let CDK Pipeline/aws_codepipeline create its own artifact bucket with the per-env removalPolicy hint honored where practical (match WebStack's removal-policy pattern using self.node.try_get_context('removalPolicy')).

Validate: from infra/ with .venv active, `npx --yes aws-cdk@2.144.0 synth RecipeMate-Staging-Pipeline -c env=staging -c githubRepo=h4n70n/recipemate -c codestarConnectionArn=arn:aws:codestar-connections:us-east-2:111111111111:connection/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000` must exit 0 with no '[Error' / 'Found errors'. Repeat with `-c env=prod` and the Prod stack name + a prod placeholder connection ARN. Also `npx cdk list` must now include the Pipeline stack for both envs.
acceptance_criteria: infra/stacks/pipeline_stack.py exists defining PipelineStack with the documented keyword-only constructor args and context parameters (githubRepo, codestarConnectionArn).
infra/app.py instantiates RecipeMate-{Staging,Prod}-Pipeline threading the ApiStack ECR repo + cluster + service, WebStack bucket + distribution, and the Secrets/Database secret references.

The pipeline defines, in order, Source (CodeStar connection, main) -> Build (backend docker build+push SHA+latest to the ApiStack ECR repo; frontend npm ci+typecheck+build) -> Test (pytest, failing exit fails the stage) -> Backend Deploy (alembic upgrade head, roll ECS service, wait for ALB /health) -> Frontend Deploy (s3 sync frontend/dist + CloudFront invalidation), with a manual approval gating the prod deploy.

No static AWS keys appear anywhere; IAM is scoped (ECR via grant_pull_push, S3 via grant_read_write/grant_delete, CloudFront invalidation scoped to the distribution ARN, ECS/secrets scoped to specific ARNs). VITE_* build config is sourced from CodeBuild env / SSM parameters, not hardcoded secrets.

`npx --yes aws-cdk@2.144.0 synth RecipeMate-Staging-Pipeline -c env=staging -c githubRepo=h4n70n/recipemate -c codestarConnectionArn=<placeholder>` exits 0 with no error lines; the `-Prod-`/`-c env=prod` equivalent also exits 0.
`npx cdk list` includes RecipeMate-Staging-Pipeline and RecipeMate-Prod-Pipeline.
verification: From infra/ with .venv active: `npx --yes aws-cdk@2.144.0 synth RecipeMate-Staging-Pipeline -c env=staging -c githubRepo=h4n70n/recipemate -c codestarConnectionArn=arn:aws:codestar-connections:us-east-2:111111111111:connection/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000`; confirm exit 0 and no '[Error' / 'Found errors'.
Repeat the synth with `RecipeMate-Prod-Pipeline -c env=prod ...` and a prod placeholder connection ARN; confirm exit 0.
`npx --yes aws-cdk@2.144.0 list -c env=staging -c githubRepo=h4n70n/recipemate` includes RecipeMate-Staging-Pipeline; `... -c env=prod ...` includes RecipeMate-Prod-Pipeline.

Grep the synthesized template (cdk.out/RecipeMate-Staging-Pipeline.template.json) to confirm a CodeStarConnections source, CodeBuild projects for backend/frontend/test, and a manual approval action are present.
findings: Implemented infra/stacks/pipeline_stack.py (PipelineStack) and wired it into infra/app.py as RecipeMate-{Staging,Prod}-Pipeline, threading ApiStack ecr_repo/cluster/service, WebStack bucket/distribution, and Database/Secrets secret refs as keyword-only args. Inline buildspecs via BuildSpec.from_object (documented in docstring). Source=CodeStar connection on main; Build=parallel backend docker build+push (SHA+latest, privileged) and frontend npm ci/typecheck/build (VITE_* from SSM PARAMETER_STORE); Test=pytest; Prod-only ManualApprovalAction gates deploys; BackendDeploy=alembic upgrade head (DATABASE_URL composed at runtime from DB secret via jq, never baked) + ecs update-service --force-new-deployment + ecs wait services-stable; FrontendDeploy=s3 sync --delete + CloudFront invalidation scoped to distribution ARN. IAM least-privilege (ecr grant_pull_push, s3 grant_read_write/grant_delete, cloudfront invalidation scoped to distribution ARN, ecs scoped to service_arn, ssm GetParameters scoped to the 7 VITE_* param ARNs, db_secret.grant_read). Artifact bucket honours per-env removalPolicy context (destroy staging / retain prod). codestarConnectionArn accepted via -c with documented placeholder default; githubRepo default DEFAULT_GITHUB_REPO='your-org/recipemate'. VERIFICATION: single-stack synth used --exclusively to validate the Pipeline template in isolation (single-stack synth without --exclusively drags in ApiStack/DatabaseStack which require AZ lookups -> credentials, a pre-existing baseline limitation per context.json). Both `npx aws-cdk@2.144.0 synth RecipeMate-Staging-Pipeline --exclusively -c env=staging ...` and the Prod equivalent (-c env=prod, prod placeholder connection ARN) exited 0 with no '[Error' / 'Found errors' / Traceback. `cdk list` for both envs includes the Pipeline stack (RecipeMate-Staging-Pipeline, RecipeMate-Prod-Pipeline). Template grep (cdk.out): CodeStarSourceConnection=1, AWS::CodeBuild::Project=5, AWS::CodePipeline::Pipeline=1 for both; Approval Category=0 for staging and 1 for prod (per-env gating confirmed); PARAMETER_STORE=7 (VITE_*), force-new-deployment=1, 'alembic upgrade head'=1; no static AWS key patterns (AKIA.../secret keys) found. Committed on local main as 5f171cb; not pushed (orchestrator publishes). Only infra/stacks/pipeline_stack.py + infra/app.py changed; cdk.out and cdk.context.json are gitignored and not committed. REVIEW-FIX ITERATION 1 (review 2026-10-04-152616, verdict NEEDS_CHANGES): (1) BLOCKING FIXED - backend deploy no longer force-deploys :latest. It now reads $IMAGE_TAG from the backend build artifact's image-tag.txt (via $CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR_BackendBuildOutput), describes the live task definition by family ($TASK_DEF_FAMILY, threaded from ApiStack.task_definition.family), rewrites the FlaskApiContainer image to $ECR_REPO_URI:$IMAGE_TAG with jq (deleting server-managed fields), registers a NEW task-def revision, and does `aws ecs update-service --task-definition <newArn>`. imagedefinitions.json/image-tag.txt are now live artifacts; deploys are traceable to a commit, rollback target is the prior revision, and the :latest race is gone. (2) FIXED - replaced `aws ecs wait services-stable` (fixed ~10min/40x15s budget) with an explicit poll loop over the PRIMARY deployment's rolloutState until COMPLETED, bounded by ROLLOUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1200 (20min), exiting non-zero on FAILED or timeout. (3) FIXED - added iam:PassRole scoped to EXACTLY the ApiStack task_role + execution_role ARNs (threaded as new keyword args task_role/execution_role from app.py), with condition iam:PassedToService=ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com; required now that we re-register a task def. Also added ecs:DescribeTaskDefinition+ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition on resource "*" (AWS does not support resource-level perms for these two actions - documented in code as an AWS constraint, not a scope omission). (4) FIXED - ecs:DescribeServices broadened from the service ARN to the cluster ARN (IAM evaluates DescribeServices at cluster granularity); ecs:UpdateService kept scoped to the service ARN. New ApiStack properties task_definition/task_role/execution_role expose these via the existing @property pattern (execution_role/task_role stored as self._... ). No constraints regressed: region still inherited from stack env (no hardcoded region strings), no static AWS keys, DB secret still fetched at runtime via jq and never echoed, GitHub source-only via CodeStar, Test stage before deploys, prod-only manual approval unchanged. RE-VERIFICATION: single-stack synth with --exclusively for BOTH envs exited 0 with no '[Error'/'Found errors'/Traceback (staging placeholder ARN; prod placeholder ARN env=prod). `cdk list` for both envs still shows RecipeMate-{Staging,Prod}-Pipeline (and app.py still assembles). Template grep (staging): iam:PassRole=1, ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition=1, --task-definition present, force-new-deployment=0, services-stable=0, image-tag.txt referenced, rolloutState poll present; PassRole scoped to the 2 role ARNs with the ecs-tasks condition, DescribeServices scoped to the cluster ARN, UpdateService to the service ARN. Files changed this iteration: infra/stacks/pipeline_stack.py, infra/stacks/api_stack.py, infra/app.py.
